Every monster you slay goes into your Bestiary, a collection shared by all the characters of your account.

Tiers: the more of a monster you kill, the more you learn of it - from Discovered to Studied, Mastered and Legendary. Each tier shows more (its stats, skills, weaknesses and drops) and makes its items drop more often for you.

Region bonus: the more monsters of a region you have found, the more experience its monsters give - up to four times as much.

Bounties: each day you get a few monsters to hunt for a reward.

Type .bestiary for the link to your collection, or open Bestiary on the Community Board (Alt+B). With a monster targeted, the page opens on it.
